'''Rycar Ryjerd''' was a [[Bimm]] weapons [[smuggler]] who spoke [[Jawaese]]. Ryjerd was present in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine]], on the [[Standard day|day]] that [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Luke Skywalker]] met [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]].<ref name="CL 2016" />{{Char-stub}}
